description: This file defines a TriangleRenderer class implementing OpenGL ES rendering for Android, including initialization, drawing frames, and resource loading, along with a Triangle class for geometric data and rendering.

classes.name: TriangleRenderer
classes.description: Implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface to render a textured triangle with OpenGL ES, managing resource creation, drawing, and viewport adjustments.

classes.name: Triangle
classes.description: Represents a geometric triangle shape, including vertex, texture coordinate buffers, index buffers, and a method to draw itself with OpenGL.

methods.name: TriangleRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and triangle object.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL state and loads texture from resources.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Renders one frame, clearing buffers, setting up view, and drawing the textured triangle.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection when surface size changes.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the triangle shape with current OpenGL context, enabling vertex and texture coordinate arrays.

methods.name: Triangle
methods.description: Constructor that sets up buffers for vertices, textures, and indices; initializes triangle geometry.
